name: Ansible
description: Installs Ansible and converges the container with a playbook through an s6-overlay oneshot at startup and the ansible-sync command.

source.description: Git repository URL (https://, ssh://, file:// or user@host:path) or absolute path of a local directory that holds the playbook. Empty installs Ansible without convergence.

playbook.description: Playbook path relative to the repository or local directory.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to track in a Git repository. Empty tracks the remote's default branch. Not valid with a local directory.

inventory.description: Inventory path relative to the repository or local directory. Empty runs against the container as `localhost`.

requirements.description: Roles and collections requirements file, relative to the repository or local directory, installed with `ansible-galaxy install -r` before each run.

args.description: Extra ansible-playbook arguments, split on spaces. Quotes, braces and other shell characters are rejected.

checkoutDir.description: Absolute path of the Git checkout. Unused with a local directory.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs the playbook. `automatic` prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

sudoUser.description: User account that may run `sudo ansible-sync`, and nothing else, through /etc/sudoers.d/ansible. Empty adds no sudo rule. `automatic` picks the first of the remote user, container user and `vscode` that is not root.
